description: Convert a time between time zones and formats (ISO, unix, RFC 2822), with DST-aware offsets. Parses ISO 8601, unix seconds/ms or "now" (a bare local time is read in the "from" zone) and returns it in UTC and in each target IANA zone with offsets, weekday, ISO week, day of year, unix seconds/ms and RFC 2822. Up to 20 target zones. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
